prog_a.title: X-frame
prog_a.summary: X-frame, phase 1, weeks 1-4 of 16 (cut phase). Lower-body sets reduced by one per exercise in weeks 1-4 while legs adapt.
prog_a.progressionNotes:
Double progression: when every set hits the top of the rep range at the target RIR, add ~2.5-5% load next session.
Schedule: Mon Lower A, Tue Upper A, Thu Lower B, Fri Upper B. Wed, Sat, Sun rest.
RIR: Leg compounds never below 2 RIR. No failure and no intensifiers in weeks 1-4.
Recovery gate: Move to the next week only if key lifts held or rose, no joint pain above 3/10, and sleep/motivation are OK.
Not trained directly: Calves and traps (client preference).
